title: Loud and Rich
summary: Given a group of n people with unique amounts of money and quietness levels, and a list indicating wealth relationships, determine the least quiet person who is at least as wealthy as each individual.
statement: Given a group of n people with unique amounts of money and quietness levels, and a list indicating wealth relationships, determine the least quiet person who is at least as wealthy as each individual. Return an array where each element represents the least quiet person for the corresponding individual.
constraints: richer pairs [a,b] mean a is richer than b; relations are consistent.
For each person return the quietest person known to be at least as rich.
hints: Each answer depends on the answers of directly richer neighbors, forming memoizable graph ancestry.
Build edges from poorer to richer and DFS for the quietest reachable candidate.
solve(p)=argmin quiet among p and solve(richer neighbors).
Consistency makes the relation acyclic, and recursion considers every richer ancestor exactly through its incoming chain.
editorial: Consistency makes the relation acyclic, and recursion considers every richer ancestor exactly through its incoming chain.

tests.explanation: With no richer relation, the only person selects themself.
